overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the video of the June 14 meeting showed no whispering among Council members, let alone among a quorum. Resolved by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged council members whispered to each other at a volume the public could not hear, which the complaint said violated the Open Meeting Law.
